payload.evidence: Stated instrument run (ic): the built Debug bundle (~/.local/state/intent/build/.../Intent.app) launched under a deliberately minimal environment (env -i HOME PATH=/usr/bin:/bin, no dev PATH); os_log shows 'launched; intent: native/rust/target/release/intent (login shell: /Users/matts/.local/bin/intent)' -- resolved via the CAPTURED LOGIN-SHELL PATH, not the launch env. Positive+negative controlled: /bin/zsh -ilc (capture()'s command) recovers the login PATH and finds intent under env -i, while a naive bare-PATH child sees NONE. LoginShell + IntentCLI is the one shell-out home, PATH handed to every child; parse() unit-tested (LoginShellTests). Bundle launch cleaned up orphan-free.
